## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
DharmaNexus corroborates the parallel with MĀ 191 (ZH_T01_0026_049, 69 matches) and aligns MN 122 with Tibetan sūtras and Sanskrit texts such as the *Divyāvadāna*, *Avadānaśataka*, and *Śrāvakabhūmi* [DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali Canon, DharmaNexus records extensive text reuse across the *Aṅguttaranikāya* (AN 9, AN 4, AN 5, AN 10, AN 8) and *Saṁyuttanikāya* (SN 22, SN 56), as well as shared formulas with its companion text MN 121 (*Cūḷasuññata Sutta*) and the *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23) [DharmaNexus].
